<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex062042025-05-2010-51-13" status="reviewed">
         <milestone n="Incipit" unit="section"/>
         <pb n="1b"/><lb n="1b1"/> rgya gar skad du | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5111">ma hA yA na ud ta ra tan tra shA s+tra a laM kA ra puSH pa</rs> nA ma | bod skad du | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5111">theg pa chen po <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3749">rgyud bla ma</rs>'i bstan bcos kyi rgyan gyi me tog</rs> ces bya ba | 
 <milestone n="Invocation" unit="section"/>
         'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo || 
          <milestone n="Introductory verses" unit="section"/>
         <lb n="1b2"/> <lg><l>skye gcig mngon par <choice><reg>byang chub</reg><orig>‹byang chub›</orig></choice> 'tshang rgya ba ||</l> <l>dga' ldan bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal nas ||</l> <l>thub pa'i dbang po'i theg chen gsung rab kyi ||</l> <l>mthar thug nges pa'i don 'di <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4006">bdag</rs> gis bshad ||</l></lg> </seg></TEI>
